programme.title: Les Super-héros : Comment ont-ils Conquis le Monde ?
programme.desc: Des comics à Hollywood, l'incroyable ascension des super-héros devenus un phénomène mondial.

programme.title: Comment Savoir
programme.desc: Lisa ne vivait que pour sa passion du sport et du softball, mais sa soudaine exclusion de son club la laisse complètement désemparée. C'est alors qu'elle fait la connaissance de Matty, un joueur de baseball professionnel, séducteur invétéré plutôt nombriliste...

programme.title: Juste un peu d'alchimie
programme.desc: Oli tombe amoureuse d'Eric, une étoile brillante du cinéma et de la télévision. Elle va vivre une merveilleuse romance dans un monde de glamour.

programme.title: Amour Aveugle
programme.desc: Un romancier new-yorkais est rendu aveugle par un accident de voiture qui tue sa femme. Des années plus tard, il retrouve l'envie de vivre et d'écrire lorsqu'il commence une aventure avec une femme négligée par son mari, un homme d'affaires.

programme.title: Get a Job
programme.desc: Jeunes diplômés tout juste sortis de l'université, Will (Teller) et Jillian (Kendrick) se voient rapidement confrontés aux obstacles auxquels les jeunes font face aujourd'hui sur un marché de l'emploi où la concurrence fait rage.

programme.title: Hitch
programme.desc: New York "date doctor" Alex Hitchens (Will Smith) tries to charm gossip columnist Sara Melas (Eva Mendes) at the same time he is coaching shy Albert (Kevin James) on how to win the love of beautiful heiress Allegra Cole (Amber Valletta).

programme.title: Love & Radio Star
programme.desc: Savannah est engagée pour redorer l'image du quatrième animateur radio de New York. Mais lorsqu'elle se retrouve accidentellement à l'antenne avec lui, elle devient elle-même partie intégrante de la nouvelle image de l'émission et découvre si leurs différences à l'antenne ou l'amour auront le dernier mot.

programme.title: Marcher vers l'Amour
programme.desc: Lorsque son musée d'art fait face à des problèmes financiers, une conservatrice conventionnelle collabore avec un artiste d'avant-garde pour créer une exposition hors du commun. Elle apprend à sortir des sentiers battus pour sauver le musée et trouver l'amour.

programme.title: Le combat d'une femme
programme.desc: Après avoir été violée, Debbie Smith n'a pas pris la loi en main. Elle a écrit la loi.

programme.title: Le carrefour du parc
programme.desc: "Il est midi dans un parc isolé au pied des collines de Los Angeles. April est venue pour se suicider Krysta et Dennis s'échangent des tendresses dans sa voiture tandis que son collègue Ian attend dans une camionnette de lavage pour chiens Peg, l'épouse de Dennis, et sa meilleure amie Claire les ont suivis et prévoient une guérilla amoureuse et quatre jeunes trentenaires du même bureau discutent dans une autre camionnette. April demande de l'aide à Ian (du lubrifiant, un tuyau, un briquet), qui lui demande s'il peut l'accompagner. Claire et Peg piègent les amants dans la voiture de Dennis puis ont une conversation intime. Nathan et Babar avouent à Meredith et Cheryl qu'ils sont nudistes, tandis que Meredith insiste pour dire que les deux hommes sont gays. Les vêtements tombent et les vérités éclatent. Est-ce juste une journée de plus à Los Angeles ?"

programme.title: Deadly Past
programme.desc: Un barman se réconcilie avec son ex-petite amie avant de découvrir qu'il fait partie d'un stratagème criminel.

programme.title: Charlie Says
programme.desc: Le film traite de charles manson, et en particulier l'influence qu'il a eu sur une jeune femme de 19 ans.

programme.title: Nom de Code: Geronimo
programme.desc: Cette saga héroïque raconte l'incursion d'une équipe d'élite anti-terroriste en Irak.

programme.title: Le Voyage Fantastique: Des Freres Bodganov
programme.desc: Une série innovante qui éclaire des sujets captivants.

programme.title: Diablo the Ultimate Race
programme.desc: Kuba essaie de gagner rapidement de l'argent pour aider sa petite sœur très malade.

programme.title: Les Regrets
programme.desc: Mathieu Lievin, 40 ans, architecte parisien, prend la route pour rejoindre la petite ville de son enfance où sa mère vient d'être hospitalisée en urgence. Dans la rue, il croise Maya, son amour de jeunesse, qu'il n'a pas revue depuis quinze années. Accompagnée d'un homme et d'une petite fille, elle ne lui adresse pas la parole. Deux heures plus tard, le téléphone sonne dans la maison familiale : c'est Maya qui l'invite à venir la retrouver chez elle. Il hésite un court instant puis accepte..

programme.title: Une Romance Inattendue
programme.desc: Leanna se fait passer pour l'auteure mystérieuse d'un best-seller romantique écrit en secret par Michael, un écrivain snob. Mais cette supercherie pourrait bien les mener à une véritable histoire d'amour.

programme.title: La destination de Noël
programme.desc: Emma, dirigeante épuisée d'une entreprise de jouets, rêve d'échapper à Noël. Mais une erreur d'avion l'emmène dans une ville d'Alaska entièrement dédiée aux fêtes, où Connor pourrait lui redonner goût à Noël.

programme.title: L'amour sur mesure
programme.desc: La propriétaire d'une boutique de robes de mariée d'occasion aide les futures mariées à réaliser leurs rêves. Mais lorsqu'elle rencontre l'homme idéal, elle hésite à offrir une seconde chance à son propre cœur.

programme.title: Hook Ou La Revanche Du Capitaine Crochet
programme.desc: Peter Banning alias Peter Pan est devenu un brillant avocat d'affaires qui a tout oublie de ses merveilleuses aventures. Mais le terrible capitaine Crochet, lui, n'a pas oublie. Pour enfin, regler leur compte, il enleve une nuit Jack et Maggie, les enfants de Peter. C'est en compagnie de Tinkerbell que Peter s'envole a nouveau pour le pays de Nulle Part.

programme.title: The Man From Toronto
programme.desc: Teddy Jackson (Kevin Hart) est un entrepreneur empoté qui n'arrive à convaincre personne de financer ses idées. En emmenant sa femme en vacances, Teddy se retrouve dans le mauvais Airbnb et est confondu avec un redoutable tueur connu sous le nom de « l'homme de Toronto ». Lorsque le véritable assassin (Woody Harrelson) arrive, les deux se rendent compte qu'ils vont devoir travailler ensemble pour échapper aux agents tenaces du FBI, aux tueurs à gages assoiffés de sang et à leur commanditaire (Ellen Barkin) qui veut récupérer son argent. THE MAN frOM TORONTO est une comédie explosive qui déborde de scènes d'action.

programme.title: Stripes (1981)
programme.desc: Lorsque John Winger (Bill Murray) perd son travail, sa voiture, son appartement et sa petite amie dans la même journée, il décide qu'il n'a qu'une solution : se porter volontaire pour l'armée. Et il persuade son ami Russell (Harold Ramis) à s'engager avec lui. Ils ont bien réfléchi et l'armée n'est-elle pas le lieu idéal pour défendre les valeurs du monde démocratique...

programme.title: Freaks of Nature
programme.desc: Dans la ville de Dillford, vampires, humains et zombies sont habitué de vivre ensemble, mais avec l'arrivée d'extraterrestres, il se produit que les humains commence à se battre contre les vampires et les Zombies dans un combat mortel. Trois adolescents doivent maintenant essayer de faire revenir les choses à la «normale».

programme.title: George and the Dragon
programme.desc: Le jour où Luna, la fille du roi, disparaît, Georges, un valeureux chevalier, accompagné de son fidèle guerrier Garth, partent à la recherche de la princesse. En affrontant de multiples dangers, leur route va croiser celle dun gigantesque dragon et de dangereux mercenaires.

programme.title: (S)ex List
programme.desc: Anna Faris et Chris Evans se partagent la vedette dans cette comédie sur une femme célibataire qui essaie de trouver le véritable amour en se lançant dans une recherche hilarante pour trouver le meilleur ex-petit ami de sa vie.

programme.title: Mariage express
programme.desc: Un jeune homme déçu par la vie décide de cesser sa quête du grand amour jusqu'au jour où il rencontre une jeune serveuse désabusée ... Entre les deux, le coup de foudre est inévitable.

programme.title: The Promotion
programme.desc: Deux gérants adjoints d'un supermarché s'affrontent pour décrocher un poste convoité.

programme.title: Mayhem
programme.desc: Un virus se propage dans un cabinet d'avocats le jour où le jeune Derek est piégé par un collègue et injustement licencié, transformant les collaborateurs en bêtes sanguinaires.

programme.title: Bianco Apache
programme.desc: Des hors-la-loi attaquent un groupe de colons et tuent tout le monde, sauf une femme enceinte qui est sauvée par une bande d'Indiens.

programme.title: Ben et Charlie
programme.desc: Deux bandits sympathiques tentent de gagner leur vie dans le Far West.

programme.title: La vallée de la vengeance
programme.desc: Les fils d'un baron du bétail du Colorado, l'un biologique et l'autre adoptif, se détestent et se battent pour le contrôle de l'empire bovin de leur père.

programme.title: Adios Caballero
programme.desc: Stan Ross, un justicier à lunettes, arrive à Canyon City et se retrouve pris dans un conflit opposant deux factions rivales.

programme.title: Arizona Bill

programme.title: Gillian Anderson On Not Being Ashamed Of Your Fantasies
programme.desc: Gillian Anderson joins Happy Place to discuss her new book 'Want', exploring the complexities of women's sexual fantasies and the importance of being open about them with ourselves and our partners. Gillian shares how her various roles from The X-Files to Sex Education have informed the person she is today. A 50-minute conversation about sex, confidence, and being a woman.

programme.title: David Tennant On The Struggles Throughout His Acting Career
programme.desc: David Tennant discusses the anxieties and stage fright he experiences as an actor, even with critical acclaim, and how a little fear can be useful to prevent complacency. He and Fearne explore how to work through moments when anxiety threatens to overwhelm you, and how concrete experiences over time provide a coping mechanism. David also shares his thoughts on whether celebrities should use their platform for social activism, and verifies some stories from online about his life.

programme.title: Dave Grohl On Overcoming Fear And Pursuing Your Dream
programme.desc: Foo Fighters and Nirvana drummer Dave Grohl discusses his new memoir The Storyteller, written during the pandemic. He talks with Fearne Cotton about the law of attraction, pursuing your dreams, and the importance of embracing mistakes and the unknown. Grohl reflects on his journey from hitting the road with Scream at 18 to his time in Nirvana and Foo Fighters, and how storytelling shaped his life from childhood in Springfield, Virginia.

programme.title: Chris McCausland: My Body Rests But My Brain Doesn't!
programme.desc: Comedian Chris McCausland chats with Fearne Cotton about holidays and travel. Chris explains how losing his sight has changed the way he approaches holidays, from planning activities and communicating in foreign countries to managing his dependence on loved ones. He discusses getting into his daughter's favourite holiday hobby: rollercoasters.

programme.title: Ant & Dec On Anxiety, Gratitude & Turning 50
programme.desc: In their first ever podcast appearance, Ant and Dec join Fearne and explain that nearly four decades into their careers they're still laughing together just as much as they did at the beginning, but now they've got far more gratitude for each day they get to be on TV.

programme.title: Caitlin Moran On How She Finally Calmed Her Nervous System
programme.desc: Writer Caitlin Moran discusses her 30-year battle with anxiety that began at age 13, and how she's now two years anxiety-free through choosing to be hopeful and see the good in life. She talks with Fearne Cotton about how social media has altered our perception of reality, the difference between posting angrily online and taking real-world action, social anxiety when meeting friends, and how presuming everyone's having a bad day can make you happier.

programme.title: Ashley Roberts On Coping With Anxiety And Insomnia
programme.desc: Ashley Roberts discusses her journey through burnout and body shaming during the height of the Pussycat Dolls' fame, and how discovering breathwork helped her recover from intense anxiety and physical ill-health. She talks about her mental health toolkit, the grief of losing her dad to suicide, and family mental illness. With Fearne Cotton, she shares experiences of insomnia and coping strategies.

programme.title: Adam Kay Opens Up About The PTSD That Made Him Leave The NHS
programme.desc: Former doctor Adam Kay discusses the traumatic day at work that left him with PTSD and led to his decision to leave the NHS. He explains how the experience affected his mental health, leaving him feeling paranoid and overcautious, and how he turned to diary writing to process his emotions. Adam and Fearne discuss mental health stigma in the workplace and at home, and offer advice for building mental health toolkits for crises of varying severity. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicide.

From viral TikTok trends to A-list guilty pleasures, they try and rate Dua Lipa's Pickle Diet Coke, Channing Tatum's Peanut Butter, Jelly & Cheetos Sandwich, and Beyoncé's Banana with Ketchup. Will these celebrity creations be surprisingly delicious or completely disgusting. Our Old People give their brutally honest verdicts.

programme.title: Keir Starmer's Weirdest Moments As Prime Minister
programme.desc: Keir Starmer's time in office has come to a close. His legacy includes some strange moments. From meeps to releasing sausages to going footy mad, relive all of the best and worst moments from the last two years. Hear clashes with Rishi Sunak and Kemi Badenoch, awkward encounters with Donald Trump, and gaffes at various major summits.

programme.title: AI CEOs Being Absolutely Insane
programme.desc: Have you ever paid attention to the voices behind the 'inevitable' AI revolution? OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Palantir's Alex Karp are among the tech elite. They're building the models they claim will change work, politics, and life forever. But when they talk about this future, their rhetoric ranges from bizarre to sinister. From Musk's prediction that there's "a 10 to 20% chance of killer robots wiping out humanity" to Altman's sale of intelligence as utility, things look pretty bleak.

programme.title: Donald Trump's Most Embarrassing Moments
programme.desc: Donald Trump has a lot to say about the world. That doesn't mean he knows what he's talking about. From China to Venezuela and Canada to the UK, watch Trump's questionable comments about all corners of the globe.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Generational
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Generational, a series bringing together football fans from every generation to debate the biggest talking points in the game. Topics include whether the Premier League has ruined football, if players from the 60s and 70s could cope in today's game, whether Jack Grealish is better than Pelé, if the FA Cup is still a major trophy, and whether Manchester City should be stripped of their trophies if found guilty. Different generations bring different perspectives, experiences and opinions, with plenty of disagreement and passionate arguments throughout.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: JOE Pub Quiz with TommyInnit and Max Fosh
programme.desc: TommyInnit and Max Fosh go head-to-head in the Joe Pub Quiz with a YouTube twist, battling it out across rounds testing their knowledge of the platform, iconic YouTube moments and some of the biggest names in internet history. From guessing who said which iconic line, to throwback YouTube apologies from Logan Paul, classic Sidemen diss tracks and a final rapid-fire round where they have to identify famous YouTubers from photos. Along the way, Tommy and Max also get into some of the biggest debates in YouTube history, including whether we need to bring proper YouTube apologies back, the golden era of diss tracks and what KSI leaving the Sidemen means for them.

programme.title: The Movie Elimination Quiz
programme.desc: 10 people go head to head in a movie quiz to see who will be the last one standing. If they get one question wrong they have to sit. programme.desc: Eddie Hall and Expressions take on a quiz about the Sidemen, Gen Z slang, old-school phrases, and iconic Sidemen quotes. programme.title: Ne-Yo Rates British Food, Tea, & Slang
programme.desc: Ne-Yo takes on The British Test, from making the perfect British cup of tea to trying Scampi Fries for the first time. The R&B superstar is thrown headfirst into UK culture, talks about what it means to perform in the UK, reveals why he'd love to be the 'Black Ed Sheeran', discusses what it's like to work with Pitbull, admits his crush on Leona Lewis, gives his thoughts on UK style, and hilariously trolls Jake Paul along the way.

programme.title: On The Ground At Tommy Robinson's Rally
programme.desc: Around 60,000 people gathered at Parliament Square on 16 May for Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally, ostensibly to defend freedom, protect children, and take the country back. It was the smaller of two protests in central London, with at least a quarter of a million attending a pro-Palestine rally commemorating the 78th anniversary of the Nakba and uniting against the far-right. On the rally's main stage, a man covered in bacon played the cello.

programme.title: Hugh Jackman Takes On The Irish Test
programme.desc: Hugh Jackman steps up to the ultimate Irish test, trying his hand at making a proper Irish breakfast with mixed results, sharing thoughts on Ryan Reynolds, and tackling classic Irish challenges. Expect plenty of laughs and chaos as Hugh takes on various Irish cultural tasks.

programme.title: Kneecap Interview
programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Glen Powell Takes The Irish Test
programme.desc: Glen Powell and Edgar Wright are put to the test to see if they can earn themselves an honourary Irish passport. To do so, they must pass a series of tests to prove their Irishness. Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth's biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet's temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Montenegro

There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Rugged coasts, untouched nature and the rough climate of the Atlantic characterize the landscape on the west coast of Scotland. In the sounds and lochs of the Scottish West, "Waverley", the last seaworthy passenger steamship in the world, appears once a year. The side-wheel steamer was built in 1947 to carry out short ferry passages on the Clyde River. Today, "Waverley" circumnavigates almost all of Great Britain. The impressive ship was sold to the "Paddle Steamer Preservation Society" in 1974 for the symbolic price of one English pound. Since then, she starts her season off the Western Isles in Scotland every year in May.

For every human inhabitant of Berlin there are at least two birds, and nowhere else are so many sparrows and nightingales to be found as in Germany's capital. Swarms of bees harvest the honey from the city's almost half a million trees, while badgers can be found scurrying across courtyards and praying mantises await their prey in strips of railway land. The metropolis of Berlin is an urban jungle, providing a habitat for thousands of racoons, foxes, bats, squirrels, hedgehogs and beavers - Berlin is wild in more ways than one.

programme.title: To the North
programme.desc: Benny Rebel approaches a big cat in the semi desert with caution. An Asiatic cheetah is like an icon of Iranian nature. The carnivore accepts Benny in its closer environment. The photographer takes breath taking shots. Rewarded in this way Rebel continues his challenging expedition in a high mood. Deep in the desert he manages to come close to the last Wild Ass, so called Onager. The horse like animals are very shy and rare. From his hideouts Benny observes chinkaras, antelopes and impressive horned wild sheep in the mountains. Passing the snow topped Mount Damavand he reaches the green north part of Iran. In the oldest national park Golestan not only massive Marals and wild boars roam. Here also Persian leopards and brown bears crossing their ways. Near the mystical forest of Persia the journey ends at the biggest inland lake of the world: the Caspian Sea. There Benny stalks on the pink flamingoes which gather there for feeding. The number and variety of species and landscapes of Iran is overwhelming but also endangered. On his photo and film expedition Benny Rebel documents the natural resources of Iran - also, to convince the government of his home country to protect their unique treasures of nature and culture.

programme.title: Can Of Worms
programme.desc: Lloyd moves in and tries to make nice by helping out with chores, but he just gets in the way. Pythor has awoken the Vipoids and the Constrictaurs and an all out snake war has taken over Ninjago. The Ninja are not faring well, when a mysterious Samurai shows up and saves the day.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: Chased Dreamers
programme.desc: To craft their own hourglasses and become official Dream Chasers for the Night Bureau, Mateo and his friends must defeat the Dream Forge guardian.

programme.title: The Dream Forge
programme.desc: As time runs out to face the Dream Forge and become official Dream Chasers, Mateo and his friends enlist the help of the mysterious Dream Bandit.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: Mia moglie, un corpo per l'amore

programme.title: Splendori e Miserie di Madame Royale

programme.title: Ieri, oggi e domani
programme.desc: Trio di novelle, tre ritratti di donna che si avvalgono dell`eclettico brio interpretativo di Sophia Loren. Da un soggetto di Eduardo De Filippo: "Adelina", napoletana che vende sigarette di contrabbando e, per evitare il carcere, sforna figli a ripetizione da una novella di Aberto Moravia: "Anna", ricca milanese che, per noia, tradisce il marito con un giovane intellettuale squattrinato da un soggetto di Cesare Zavattini: "Mara", squillo d`alto bordo che fa invaghire un giovane seminarista.

programme.title: Casanova 70
programme.desc: Andrea, ufficiale della Nato, è colpito da un`ossessione che lo spinge a compiere azioni rischiose per le sue conquiste galanti. Lo psicanalista, ascoltato il racconto delle sue avventure, gli rimprovera l`eccessiva frenesia amorosa e gli consiglia una vacanza di riposo in montagna. Ma anche in vacanza Andrea non perde il vizio di correre dietro alle donne...

programme.title: L'ingorgo
programme.desc: Un corteo di macchine procede sempre più lentamente lungo la tangenziale di Roma, sino a che ogni possibilità di movimento si blocca. L`ingorgo durerà 36 ore. Sin dai primi momenti il nervosismo dei viaggiatori è evidente. Quando sfumano le speranze di una veloce soluzione, mancano notizie, si palesano le prime necessità, la tensione sale al massimo e non pochi trascendono. La circostanza permette di scoprire i lati peggiori dell`umanità presente...

programme.title: Rappresaglia
programme.desc: Roma 23 Marzo 1944. Le truppe tedesche tengono la città sotto il loro controllo. In seguito ad un attentato contro una compagnia delle SS compiuto in via Rasella, il generale Maelzer informa i suoi capi a Berlino che, decisi ad abrogare qualunque soglia di tolleranza, ordinano una veloce rappresaglia, pretendendo l`esecuzione di dieci italiani per ogni tedesco ucciso. Sarà il tenente colonnello Herbert Kapller a gestire l`intervento e a compilare la lista dei sacrificati, nonostante il suo aperto dissenso.

programme.title: Animali selvatici

Convinto di trovare immediatamente un altro lavoro all'altezza del suo curriculum, dopo oltre due anni di ricerche si ritrova ancora disoccupato. Decide così di mettere in atto un piano destinato a restituirgli il lavoro presso la principale azienda del settore, la Arcadia. Il piano consiste nell'eliminazione fisica di tutti i suoi principali concorrenti, altri manager che come lui hanno perso il posto e vivono di espedienti partecipando ad umilianti colloqui di lavoro.

programme.title: Avamposto telegrafico

programme.title: End of Sentence

Quando Sean esce di prigione, l'ultima cosa che ha in mente è un viaggio all'estero con il padre alienato. Quello di cui ha bisogno è un nuovo inizio in California. Ma quando i suoi piani di viaggio vanno a monte, accetta con riluttanza la proposta del padre in cambio di un biglietto per la West Coast e della promessa di non rivedersi mai più. Tra una sconcertante veglia irlandese, il riaffiorare di una vecchia fiamma, il rimorchio di una bella autostoppista e un sacco di questioni irrisolte, il viaggio diventa un po' più di quanto padre e figlio avessero previsto.
